recipes.prompt: Create one standalone botanical illustration for The Vegetable Guru inner pages, not a page layout. References 2 and 3 are the APPROVED BOOK HERO ART and must govern drawing style: bold simplified silhouettes, broad crisp colour and shadow planes, dimensional hand-shaped vector-like botanical drawing, rich natural crop colours, lime and forest greens, tapered cream highlight slashes and occasional rhythmic scalloped highlights, a few major veins only. No fine ink hatching, no watercolour, no pencil, no grain or mottled texture, no photographic skin gloss, no black outline. Ignore and DO NOT reproduce the reference heroes' green/black background haze. Truly transparent PNG background, no glow, no halo, no cast shadow or ground plane, no white backing, no lettering or border. Keep entire silhouette inside canvas with 7% clear padding. Large high resolution. Landscape 3:2 composition. Isolate a loose low harvest group from the photo: the two curved long dark-green chillies at the left and four uneven squat lobed peppers from the centre/right (one red, one orange, two green). Keep their observed irregular lobing, downward/sideways orientations, varied size and slight overlap; arrange as a relaxed shallow arc derived from their positions in the photograph, not a uniform row or decorative symmetry. All stalks should have natural endpoints. Omit the kitchen board, every background object and other peppers. Complete any edges clipped by the photo sparingly. No leaves invented for harvested fruits.
